name: Adversarial defense benchmark for EEG-based BCIs (data alignment)
description: A benchmark suite that evaluates data-alignment-based adversarial defenses for EEG-based brain–computer interfaces, measuring robustness against adversarial perturbations and defense efficacy.
reputation: Niche benchmark used primarily within the BCI and neuroengineering robustness community.
notes: Domain-specific, subject-to-subject variability, often small datasets; non-LLM benchmark and sensitive human data considerations.
